newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 590,900 metric tons (MT) were three and one-third times the previous week and more than two and four-fifths times the 4-week average.

Increases reported for Pakistan (135,000 MT), Taiwan (87,600 MT), the Philippines (84,000 MT), Japan (81,800 MT), and Armenia (62,900 MT) were partly offset by decreases for unknown destinations (25,500 MT).

Exports of 342,300 MT equaled the prior week and were 28 percent above the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (82,400 MT), Yemen (40,000 MT), Nigeria (39,700 MT), Taiwan (33,400 MT), and Israel (29,900 MT).
